content:
Just not in a good way.

Kimmel warned that Trump, who frequently insists that elections are "stolen," is coming prepared for the November midterms.

"He is trying every possible way to steal this election himself," Kimmel said. "The Supreme Court shot down his plan to stop mail-in ballots. So now he's proposing that if Republicans win — only if they win — he'll give every adult five thousand dollars, and that is truly insane. Equally insane is this idea of treating our own money as some kind of gift to give back to us."

Kimmel then played clips of Trump making similar remarks before, including a two-thousand-dollar tariff dividend he promised last year but never delivered.

Kimmel said: "I think all of us — that is, those of us who didn't vote for Trump — assumed he'd be even worse the second time. But even I didn't expect him to be this bad."

Kimmel then asked his audience: "Has anyone done anything worse?"

The audience responded instantly with one loud word: "No!"

Kimmel said: "Kitty and José Menendez were better parents than Trump is at running this country," referring to the parents of Lyle and Erik Menendez. The brothers are currently serving life sentences for killing their own parents.
